+# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+
+import copy
+import inspect
+import pickle
+
+from types import MappingProxyType
+
+import attr
+import pytest
+
+
+class SignatureOnly:
+    __slots__ = ("__signature__", "calls", "takes_self", "takes_field")
+
+    def __init__(self, takes_self, takes_field):
+        self.takes_self = takes_self
+        self.takes_field = takes_field
+        self.calls = []
+        names = ["value"]
+        if takes_self:
+            names.append("instance")
+        if takes_field:
+            names.append("field")
+        self.__signature__ = inspect.Signature(
+            [
+                inspect.Parameter(
+                    name,
+                    inspect.Parameter.POSITIONAL_OR_KEYWORD,
+                    annotation=str if index == 0 else inspect.Parameter.empty,
+                )
+                for index, name in enumerate(names)
+            ],
+            return_annotation=int,
+        )
+
+    def __call__(self, value, *context):
+        self.calls.append((value, context))
+        result = int(value)
+        if self.takes_self:
+            result += context[0].offset
+        if self.takes_field:
+            result += len(context[-1].name)
+        return result
+
+
+class ReadOnlyAnnotations(SignatureOnly):
+    __slots__ = ()
+
+    @property
+    def __annotations__(self):
+        return MappingProxyType({"value": bytes, "return": bytes})
+
+
+def exercise(wrapped):
+    @attr.define
+    class Model:
+        offset: int = attr.field(init=False, default=3)
+        value: int = attr.field(converter=wrapped)
+
+    field = attr.fields(Model).value
+    obj = Model("10")
+    expected = 10 + (3 if wrapped.takes_self else 0)
+    expected += 5 if wrapped.takes_field else 0
+    assert obj.value == expected
+    assert Model.__init__.__annotations__["value"] is str
+    assert wrapped.__call__.__annotations__["return"] is int
+
+    context = ()
+    if wrapped.takes_self:
+        context += (obj,)
+    if wrapped.takes_field:
+        context += (field,)
+    assert wrapped.converter.calls[-1][0] == "10"
+    assert len(wrapped.converter.calls[-1][1]) == len(context)
+    assert all(a is b for a, b in zip(wrapped.converter.calls[-1][1], context))
+
+    assert attr.setters.convert(obj, field, "20") == expected + 10
+    assert obj.value == expected
+    obj.value = "30"
+    assert obj.value == expected + 20
+    assert [v for v, _ in wrapped.converter.calls] == ["10", "20", "30"]
+    for _, actual in wrapped.converter.calls:
+        assert len(actual) == len(context)
+        assert all(a is b for a, b in zip(actual, context))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("takes_self,takes_field", [(False, False), (True, False), (False, True), (True, True)])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("callable_type", [SignatureOnly, ReadOnlyAnnotations])
+def test_callable_protocol(callable_type, takes_self, takes_field):
+    callback = callable_type(takes_self, takes_field)
+    before = dict(callback.__annotations__) if callable_type is ReadOnlyAnnotations else None
+    wrapped = attr.Converter(callback, takes_self=takes_self, takes_field=takes_field)
+    exercise(wrapped)
+    if before is not None:
+        assert dict(callback.__annotations__) == before
+    else:
+        assert not hasattr(callback, "__annotations__")
+
+
+def test_function_annotation_ownership():
+    def callback(value: bytes, instance, field) -> bytes:
+        return int(value) + instance.offset + len(field.name)
+
+    callback.__signature__ = inspect.signature(callback).replace(
+        parameters=[
+            p.replace(annotation=str) if p.name == "value" else p
+            for p in inspect.signature(callback).parameters.values()
+        ],
+        return_annotation=int,
+    )
+    annotations = callback.__annotations__
+    before = dict(annotations)
+    first = attr.Converter(callback, takes_self=True, takes_field=True)
+    second = attr.Converter(callback, takes_self=True, takes_field=True)
+    assert callback.__annotations__ is annotations
+    assert annotations == before
+    assert first.__call__ is not callback
+    assert first.__call__ is not second.__call__
+    assert first.__call__.__annotations__["return"] is int
+    assert second.__call__.__annotations__["return"] is int
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("takes_self,takes_field", [(False, False), (True, False), (False, True), (True, True)])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("method", ["copy", "deepcopy", "pickle"])
+def test_serialization(method, takes_self, takes_field):
+    callback = SignatureOnly(takes_self, takes_field)
+    original = attr.Converter(callback, takes_self=takes_self, takes_field=takes_field)
+    assert original.__getstate__() == {
+        "converter": callback,
+        "takes_self": takes_self,
+        "takes_field": takes_field,
+    }
+    if method == "pickle":
+        restored = pickle.loads(pickle.dumps(original, protocol=pickle.HIGHEST_PROTOCOL))
+    else:
+        restored = getattr(copy, method)(original)
+    assert restored.takes_self is takes_self
+    assert restored.takes_field is takes_field
+    exercise(restored)
+    assert not hasattr(callback, "__annotations__")
+    assert not hasattr(restored.converter, "__annotations__")

spec.question: Fix attr.Converter's handling of callable annotations. Constructing a Converter must leave the supplied callable's __annotations__ unchanged and must not require that attribute to exist or be writable. This includes callable objects that expose their input and return annotations only through an inspectable __signature__, for every combination of takes_self and takes_field. Keep invocation annotations local to each Converter, retaining the inferred return annotation on its invocation adapter and the inferred first-parameter annotation in generated constructor signatures. Conversion must continue to receive the value, instance, and Attribute in the documented order, both during generated initialization and through attr.setters.convert or later mutable assignment. Preserve Converter's existing serialized state and its behavior after copying or pickle restoration. Return a unified diff against production files only; leave tests unchanged.

Require an instance-local invocation wrapper so construction never changes the original callable's __annotations__ or requires that attribute to exist. Include a callable object whose inspectable __signature__ supplies a return annotation but which has no writable __annotations__, and verify that it works both through generated initialization and src/attr/setters.py::convert.
